description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named 'TimesheetSearchFilterParams' used for filtering timesheet search queries. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and includes properties such as 'fromDate', 'toDate', and 'empNumber' to specify search criteria, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: TimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying filter parameters in timesheet searches, including date range and employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date for the timesheet search filter.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date for the timesheet search filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date for the timesheet search filter.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date for the timesheet search filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
